summary.text: On Innistrad, a plane of vampires, werewolves and the undead, the archangel Avacyn was forged by Sorin Markov to protect humanity, and her angels held the monsters back until she was drawn into the Helvault along with the demon Griselbrand.

With Avacyn gone, holy wards fail and the Church's power wanes, leaving the humans of Thraben, Kessig and beyond to face growing terror, such as the werewolf slaughter at Avabruck and the undead war of Gisa and Geralf Cecani.
Liliana Vess arrives hunting her demon masters, and the sundering of the Helvault frees Avacyn, but she and her angels become corrupted and turn on humanity.
